# betterado_dashboard (Resource)

Manages an Azure DevOps Dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "Example Project"
}

resource "betterado_team" "example" {
  project_id = betterado_project.example.id
  name       = "Example Team"
}

# Project-scoped dashboard
resource "betterado_dashboard" "project_dashboard" {
  project_id       = betterado_project.example.id
  name             = "My Project Dashboard"
  description      = "An example project-scoped dashboard managed by Terraform"
  refresh_interval = 5
}

# Team-scoped dashboard
resource "betterado_dashboard" "team_dashboard" {
  project_id       = betterado_project.example.id
  team_id          = betterado_team.example.id
  name             = "My Team Dashboard"
  description      = "An example team-scoped dashboard managed by Terraform"
  refresh_interval = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the Dashboard.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Project.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the Dashboard.
- `refresh_interval` (Number) The interval for the client to automatically refresh the Dashboard. Expressed in minutes. Valid values: 0 (disabled), 5.
- `team_id` (String) The ID of the team associated with the Dashboard. If not provided, the Dashboard is project-scoped.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `owner_id` (String) The ID of the owner of the Dashboard.
